ruleDefinitions.name: Notepad Password Files Discovery
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of Notepad to open a file that has the string "password" which may indicate unauthorized access to credentials or suspicious activity.

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\explorer\\\.exe$") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\notepad\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX("password*\\\.txt$") OR process_command_line = RGX("password*\\\.csv$") OR process_command_line = RGX("password*\\\.doc$") OR process_command_line = RGX("password*\\\.xls$")))
